subject: history
concept: Understanding daily life in a medieval castle and village
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines illustrated scenes of castle and village life and identifies daily tasks
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a daily-life object to the person who would have used it
exercise.abstract: Student describes one aspect of daily life for a person of a described medieval role

misconception_flags: assumes daily life was identical for all medieval social classes

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
